title: Enlarged Gallbladder with Gallstone and Acute Cholecystitis
author: Mikael Häggström
caption: Medical illustration of an enlarged, inflamed gallbladder with gallstone impaction causing cystic duct obstruction and acute cholecystitis.
alt_text: Labeled illustration of gallbladder distension, wall thickening, and gallstone obstruction in acute cholecystitis.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates gallstone impaction underlying biliary colic and acute cholecystitis (CLIFF-029, p.1, p.8).
